vulnerability_analysis: The buy fee logic incorrectly deducts fees from the Uniswap pair (sender) instead of from the buyer's received amount. When taxStatus is true and someone buys tokens, the contract transfers marketingFee and burnFee from the pair's balance to marketing address and burns from pair, but the buyer still receives the full amount (minus liquidity fee which seems missing in the buy path). This allows draining the pair's token balance.
attack_strategy: 1. Enable taxes by impersonating owner. 2. Buy tokens from the pair to trigger the flawed buy fee logic. 3. The pair will lose tokens to marketing/burn but we receive nearly full amount. 4. Sell tokens back (might pay sell fees but we still profit).
step_by_step_plan: 1. Impersonate owner to enable taxStatus. 2. Get some BNB to buy tokens. 3. Buy tokens via router swapETHForTokens. 4. The buy will trigger fee deduction from pair balance. 5. Check profit by comparing token balance increase vs BNB spent.
